summary: Task 10 tests reviewed inline. All 13 TDD anchors from task-file covered; smoke scenario from Verify-smoke included as integration test. 24 new tests, all green. Full suite: 383 passed (was 359).

findings.finding: Tests use tempfile-DB + SQLite fixtures matching the project's integration-test pattern (tests/test_idle_fallback.py, tests/test_job_prep_phase.py). Mocks _fallback_publish at integration boundaries but exercises the real repo (insert_pending, list_pending_for_eviction, increment_attempt, move_to_failed, move_to_published).
Byte-exact assertEqual on the admin-ping string (both the all-staged and mixed-eviction variants) + a dedicated suffix test — format is pinned. Any future drift will fail loudly.

test_job_overflow_smoke_mixed_queue covers Verify-smoke — queue pre-filled to cap with staged+unstaged mix, job() runs the full prep pass, staged rows survive, unstaged rows evicted with via_review=False. Real repo + real job() body, only _fallback_publish and fetch_full_article mocked.
Three happy-path variants (fresh, title-printing, index-2) cover the TDD anchor. failed_at timestamps pinned explicitly so ORDER BY DESC is deterministic — no timing flake.

Zero, negative, above-count, and empty-queue — all four out-of-range variants tested. Also test_retry_when_already_in_pending covers the defensive repo-False path (accepts either exit code per task-file flexibility).

Pins the exact failed-footer format (Decision 8) via a single byte-exact assertion + three separate coverage tests (empty failed, empty pending, both non-empty, ordering). TestRetryListIntegration asserts list → retry index-ordering lines up — the contract that matters to the operator.

pyramid_balance.note: Unit-heavy (80%+), smoke-light (1 explicit + 4 integration via job()) — matches project's pyramid.
